 The Last of Us Season 3 Update: Why Abby will be the focus in the new season? Here's what Gabriel Luna has said
 SECTIONS The Last of Us Season 3 Update: Why Abby will be the focus in the new season? Here's what Gabriel Luna has said By Gandharv Walia , Global Desk Last Updated: Nov 20, 2026, 09:07:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis The Last of Us Season 3 is expected to wrap filming in March 2027, according to Tommy actor Gabriel Luna. The final season will be very intense and emotional. It is unlikely that Pedro Pascal will return as Joel. He may be featured in new flashbacks or visions. The final season will focus around Abby rather than Ellie.
 ANI The Last of Us Season 3 is expected to wrap filming in March 2027, according to Tommy actor Gabriel Luna. Gabriel Luna has given an update on the production of The Last of Us Season 3 . It is expected that filming will be completed in March 2027. The final season will focus around Abby rather than Ellie. It seems unlikely that Pedro Pascal will reprise his role as Joel as he died in Season 2. It has not been completely ruled out that he may be featured in new flashbacks or visions.
 The Last of Us Season 3 update
Gabriel Luna has informed about the production of the upcoming season of The Last of Us. He stated that filming began in March 2026 and is expected to finish in March 2027 in an interview with The Hollywood Reporter.
 Luna who plays Joel’s brother Tommy has also said that the cast and crew are working very hard to make sure the ending fits with the characters and story. Speaking about the final season, Luna said: "We're doing our absolute best to bring the most explosive, most heart-wrenching culmination to what has been a really beautiful five years in my life."
Luna added that the ending will be morally ambiguous, but still give an appropriate ending to the story. He wants to ensure that both the video game players and TV audience get what they expect from the series. Luna has said that a lot of effort has gone into the production. The production started in March 2026, and is set to finish in March 2027.

 Why Abby will be the focus?
The Last of Us Season 3 will centre around Abby played by Kaitlyn Dever rather than Ellie as in the first two seasons. This is similar to the structure of The Last of Us Part II (2020). After Joel dies, Ellie goes to find Abby and those responsible for killing Joel in the second game. The story switches to Abby’s perspective at a later point in the game and shows what happened during the same time period.
 The Season 2 finale in the TV series similarly sets up for this change in focus. The events in Seattle will be revisited in Season 3 and Abby’s life before and after Joel’s death will be explored. It will also show what events occurred to cause Abby to confront Ellie and Tommy.
 Cast
Several new characters will be added to the cast. These characters are associated with the Seraphites and Washington Liberation Front (WLF).
New characters are:
 Amon played by Peter Sarsgaard: A leader of the Seraphites. This character is exclusive to the TV series.
 Miriam played by Li Jun Li: A member of the Seraphites.
 Hanley played by Jason Ritter: A soldier in the WLF.
 Jerry played by Patrick Wilson: Abby’s father.
 Michelle Mao
 Clea DuVall
 Manny played by Jorge Lendeborg Jr.: Takes over from Danny Ramirez.
 Danny Ramirez had to leave the production due to scheduling conflicts. Laura Bailey who voiced and performed as Abby in the games will appear in the TV series. She will play Elizabeth a leader in the Seraphites. Ian Alexander who played Lev in the games will play Paco an original character.
